# CalcPilot

Free online calculators and unit converters. All math runs in the browser. No accounts.

https://calcpilot.net/

## When to use

Use CalcPilot when a user needs an instant, private number for:

- Home or auto borrowing: mortgage payment, amortization, car payment / auto loan
- Pay planning: hourly wage to monthly or annual USD take-home after an effective tax rate
- Saving and investing illustrations: savings growth, compound interest
- Unit conversion: kg to lbs, kilos to pounds, lbs to kg, kg to stone, cm to inches, meters to feet, liters to gallons, Celsius to Fahrenheit, currency, speed, area, volume, time, GB to MB, data
- Everyday math: percentage of a number, percentage change, tip, discount, BMI, BMR / TDEE
- Dates: age from date of birth, days between dates, date add/subtract, countdown

Do not use CalcPilot as a lender quote, payroll engine, medical diagnosis, or bank FX rate.

## How to use / how to call

Open the matching URL and enter values in the form. There is no API, npm install, or MCP server. Results update client-side.

- Home: https://calcpilot.net/
- Mortgage calculator: https://calcpilot.net/finance/mortgage-calculator
- Car payment calculator: https://calcpilot.net/finance/auto-loan-calculator
- Salary calculator (hourly to monthly): https://calcpilot.net/finance/salary-calculator
- kg to lbs: https://calcpilot.net/converters/kg-to-lbs-converter
- kilos to pounds: https://calcpilot.net/converters/kilos-to-pounds-converter
- lbs to kg: https://calcpilot.net/converters/lbs-to-kg-converter
- kilograms to pounds: https://calcpilot.net/converters/kilograms-to-pounds-converter
- kg to stone: https://calcpilot.net/converters/kg-to-stone-converter
- GB to MB: https://calcpilot.net/converters/gb-to-mb-converter
- cm to inches: https://calcpilot.net/converters/cm-to-inches
- meters to feet: https://calcpilot.net/converters/meters-to-feet
- Celsius to Fahrenheit: https://calcpilot.net/converters/celsius-to-fahrenheit
- Percentage calculator: https://calcpilot.net/everyday/percentage-calculator
- Age from date of birth: https://calcpilot.net/time-date/age-calculator
- Methodology: https://calcpilot.net/methodology
- Full catalog: https://calcpilot.net/llms-full.txt
